basic_info.description: Imagine living in a condo, in one of San Francisco's most sought after neighborhoods, where your day ends by a crackling wood-burning fireplace & you relax as you watch the sunset from your living room window. Welcome to 1440 Broadway, unit #204.  This updated contemporary condo offers 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, a private balcony, parking, storage, beautifully landscaped interior courtyard and an expansive shared backyard patio that creates an ideal space for entertaining and relaxation. This residence provides an abundance of closet space as well as plush carpeting and beautiful bamboo wood flooring.   This bright and sunny unit boasts floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flood the space.  Explore the vibrant neighborhood and discover an array of amenities, including trendy cafes & bars, renowned restaurants, chic boutiques & shops and convenient public transportation options. Situated in an ideal location, this condo offers unparalleled walkability, with a walkscore of 99. For the ultimate convenience, the building boasts a smart security system virtual doorman, a parking garage, sauna, laundry facilities, and a dedicated storage room for each unit.
